title: The European Convention says no one shall be subjected to torture or to inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment
summary: The European Convention says no one shall be subjected to torture or to inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment.
body: Article 3 of the Convention states that prohibition in those words. The source says: "ARTICLE 3 Prohibition of torture No one shall be subjected to torture or to inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment." The sentence does not contain a limitations clause of the kind written into some other articles of the same Convention.

sources.title: Convention for the Protection of Human Rights and Fundamental Freedoms, Council of Europe English text
sources.author: Convention for the Protection of Human Rights and Fundamental Freedoms, Council of Europe English text
